t74_frame.row_rule: [u32 name_len][UTF-8 profile name][95B numeric middle][ordinal u32][UID u32][UID u32][marker 0]

slots.why: row grammar: numeric middle is exactly 95B = 3 zero prefix bytes + 4 x 23B blocks (3 + 4*23 == 95; prefix is 0x000000 on 334/334 rows). The 4 x 23B reading is pinned by bytes 25/48/71/94 being the only {0,100} columns in the middle and coinciding row-by-row; the rival 3 + 4*22 + 4 split drops the group sum==100 rate from 1,519 to 583 (of 12*334).
start day: u8 0..244, schema w0sd is 0..365 and is the only day field in block 0; rel0 is the sole non-constant byte at the head of the block

precipitation group: 5 consecutive u8, each 0..100, sum == 100 on 316/334 rows (every failure is an all-zero block). Best-fitting 5B window in block 0 is rel2; intra-group order (p0..p4) is NOT decidable from data.
wind group: 5 consecutive u8, each 0..100, sum == 100 on 317/334 rows (best 5B window is rel7). Intra-group order not decidable.

temperature group: 10 consecutive u8 (rel12..rel21), each 0..100, matching the 10 temperature fields of block 0 (te,tv,t0..t7). Sum == 100 on 244/334 rows and >105 on 0/334, i.e. the group is bounded but the sum is only approximate (block 1 is the loosest at 244/334). Intra-group order not decidable.

day/night variance, 0..50 in the schema. Block 0 is 23 bytes and needs 22 fields, so exactly one byte is left over; rel1 is it. BUT the observed value set is only {0,1} (34 ones / 334), which does NOT match a 0..50 percentage. Assigned by elimination, not by value domain.

block 0 rel22: the only {0,100} column; identical row-wise across all four blocks (set of per-row value-sets == {1}), so it is a row-level property repeated per block, not a per-block field. Set on 20/334 rows whose names are arid/tropical regions (Rub Al-Khali Desert, Gobi Desert Region, Saudi *, Türkiye *, South China Sea Coast) and disjoint from the all-zero-temperature rows (0 overlap). No weather.xml field is a row-level climate flag, so it stays unassigned rather than being fitted.
